summary: Fire Watch is a web app that turns 26 years of NASA satellite fire detections into a fire calendar for any place on Earth. Older (MODIS) and newer (VIIRS) satellites count fire differently, so Fire Watch converts the older counts to the newer scale. You can then see when a place usually burns and spot unusual months. Tested on years it had never seen, the error drops from 75% to 16%. It also shows a month’s biggest fire day in 3D, in English and Spanish.
details: Fire Watch turns 26 years of NASA FIRMS fire detections into a fire calendar for any place on Earth. Older (MODIS) and newer (VIIRS) satellites count fire differently, so it converts the older counts to the newer scale. Tested on years kept out of the fitting, the error drops from 75% to 16%. Fire managers can see when a place burns, spot unusual months, check recent days, and download data in English or Spanish. Any month’s biggest fire day opens in 3D, built from real terrain. Built with TypeScript, React, Three.js, Python and Cloudflare, with error ranges and colour-blind-safe colours.
